questions.claim: What does GDT766 retire in lchor=woody plant part, and what survives as a complete-whole hypothesis?
questions.finding: The old woody-part composition remains retired. Two exact lchor occurrences are both Biological, with no stable right neighbor; the working role is internal preparation field and the bold default flower preparation, with flower extract retained as rival. This is replacement of a component-derived content default by whole-form role hypotheses, not empirical identification of flowers or falsification of every possible woody referent.
questions.root_note: GDT766 reports that the composition remains retired but does not provide a new isolated empirical wood-versus-flower test. Do not invent its earlier precise causal withdrawal evidence. Flower preparation and flower extract remain bold alternatives; the quoted phrase less specific is source wording, not root information ranking.
questions.reopening: Reconsider the retired composition only upon an explicit correction to its exact source derivation or independent whole-form evidence distinguishing woody material from flower preparation/extract. Additional occurrences without such a discriminator could change distributional support but cannot alone restore woody identity or export l/chor meanings.

questions.claim: Did the ol contextual renderer reject Grundansatz, and what did zero OL debt and later context transfer actually establish?
questions.finding: The GDT664/665 naked learned ol default was integrated by GDT683; GDT684 explicitly says repaired wording and reader boundary agreement do not establish meaning. GDT774 retains the inventory: 376 positions inherit one earlier GDT664 card, not 376 independent confirmations. Automatic rules yield49 contextual outputs and327 nominal fallbacks; only9/15 fixed calibration outputs transfer. The hybrid55/321 preserves known calibration choices. Neither this split nor nominal fallback globally refutes or proves Grundansatz, and oil/water/wine remain indistinguishable.
questions.root_note: 9/15 is calibration-output reproduction, not an independent held semantic score. The24 hand-chosen contexts are constructed rule checks and receive zero independent semantic credit. GDT774 retains rather than globally rejects the old inventory.
questions.reopening: A corrected source/boundary or portable context trigger may justify a renderer update and must be assessed as such. Promoting Grundansatz to a historical lexical meaning requires independent evidence distinguishing base preparation from relation/product alternatives; changing the display label or improving replay cannot supply it. Reopening the contextual transfer claim requires new eligible observations or a genuinely different predeclared trigger test, not manually restoring the six calibration exceptions as held successes.

limits: Source-specific historical questions only; no new manuscript measurement or restoration of any concrete material meaning.
